evidence_notes.limitation: 该文为中国CGSS 2006—2017数据，主要反映规范/责任归属观念，非实际代际经济支持；且为队列与年龄效应混合，不能直接等同于工业化因果。

evidence_notes.quote: On average, perceived filial obligation norms declined (p < .05).

evidence_notes.quote: The data in this article, however, show that the vast majority of married children, both sons and daughters, provided net financial suppor for their parents during the previous year.
